answer: One concrete sybil defense is bonded staking: each agent must lock a refundable deposit to act, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs a thousand real bonds. Misbehavior slashes the stake. Like a harbormaster at a wharf charging slip fees, honest agents bend and recover like a willow while attackers burn capital. Reputation then crystallizes into a crystal-clear, costly-to-forge signal that cheap duplicates can never match.
